title: Lightning Became 40 Times Less Deadly Per Person
hook: Lightning became 40 times less deadly, but water remains dangerous.
closing: Safety gains cut deaths dramatically, yet thunder still means every viewer should move indoors.
question: Where do you shelter during storms?

segments.say: Lightning killed 18 people in the latest year, showing safety gains reduced deaths without eliminating the danger entirely.
Per person, lightning is 40 times less deadly than before, evidence that warnings and shelter save lives.
Fishing accounts for 10 percent of recent lightning deaths, so open water remains the activity most worth avoiding during storms.
